run_nist_scorer: run the NIST scorer to evaluate machine translation hypotheses against reference translations
test_nist_scorer: test the NISTScorer class with hypothesis and reference sentence lists
create_nist_score: create a NIST score by passing hypothesis and reference sentences to the scorer
review_nist_scorer: review the NISTScorer class and its score method for evaluating translation quality
summarize_nist_scorer: summarize the NISTScorer class and _get_sent_nist function for computing NIST translation metrics
